verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships a CLI, an MCP integration and a browser feedback widget, so telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or any opt-out control. The 'opt into' wording in the docs refers only to a PR check failure threshold, and the signal:write widget-key scope limits what the key can do rather than letting users opt out of tracking.
